methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Kunin operates in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector. The comparable universe identified comprises 9 peers total—1 public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The target's stage, current valuation, and total capital raised remain undisclosed.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The analysis identified 10 same-sector peers in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none met the filtering thresholds of matching stage, adjacent-stage classification, or similar valuation tier simultaneously. This yielded fewer than three datapoints necessary for reliable median-based triangulation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial error given the heterogeneity of robotics subsegments and capital deployment models.

The absence of tightly filtered comparables creates a significant analytical constraint. Without stage-aligned or valuation-tier-aligned peers, traditional DCF or revenue multiple approaches cannot be anchored to observable market transactions. Any valuation conclusion would require either: (1) relaxing filter criteria and accepting higher comparability risk, (2) obtaining additional transaction data from the identified peer set, or (3) employing alternative methods (precedent transactions, venture capital method) not currently supported by the provided dataset. The analysis cannot responsibly triangulate a valuation range given current data sufficiency.
